Part.name: Duplet Oplot ERA module
Part.description: Placeable reactive armour. One module reacts once against eligible HEAT or APFSDS hits. Up to 55% less remaining HEAT penetration and 20% less APFSDS penetration. About 31.3 kg. Compact bolt mounts; follows vehicle paint and camouflage. Rotate the closed protective face outward; freely move, mirror and duplicate. Return to Edit to restore. Gameplay calibration; no tandem simulation. Spent mount, passive collision and mass remain.
